speakers.bio: Andrea Gennarini is Co-founder & Managing Partner at 2100 Ventures, an early-stage VC fund that backs founders building Europe's Industrial Renaissance. We invest at pre-seed and seed across AI, industrial tech and climate tech.

speakers.name: Andrea Zorzetto
speakers.bio: Cato is the AI sales tool for public bidders. Andrea is a second-time founder and launcher of Plug and Play in Italy. Has a background in public policy, including as a policy advisor for the UK Treasury.

speakers.name: Andreas Klinger
speakers.bio:
Andreas Klinger is the founder of PROTOTYPE, a first-check fund that has backed 100+ European startups across robotics, manufacturing, AI, software, and frontier tech.
Additionally, Andreas is one of the loudest voices in european tech. He runs a Youtube channel to feature European innovation and co-initiated EU–INC a proposal to create a pan-European legal entity, which is currently becoming law.

speakers.name: Andrey Khusid
speakers.bio: Andrey Khusid is the Founder and CEO of Miro, the AI Innovation Workspace for teams, which enables organizations of any size to build the next big thing. Funded by leading investors including Accel and Iconiq, Miro has more than 1,600 employees in 13 offices around the globe. It serves more than 100 million users worldwide and is used by 250,000 companies. Miro empowers cross-functional teams to flow from early discovery through final delivery on a shared, AI-first canvas.

speakers.name: Anish Acharya
speakers.bio:
Anish Acharya is an entrepreneur and general partner at Andreessen Horowitz. At a16z, he focuses on consumer investing, including AI-native products and companies that will help usher in a new era of abundance. Anish first joined the firm in 2019 with a focus on fintech, often investing in B2C technologies. He currently serves on the boards of Clutch, Deel, HappyRobot, Mosaic, Method, The Coterie, and Titan. He is also a board observer at Arc, Carbonated, and [untitled].
Prior to joining Andreessen Horowitz, Anish founded and sold two consumer companies, successfully navigating multiple technology platform shifts.
In 2014, Anish founded Snowball, a universal inbox for Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, SMS, and other mobile messaging clients to help consumers rethink how they communicate online. After Snowball was acquired by Credit Karma in 2015, he served as GM of Core Consumer and GM of Cards. He helped scale the U.S. Card to over 100 million members and nearly $1 billion in 2019 revenue.
In 2008, Anish co-founded SocialDeck. As an “anywhere, anytime, anyone” social gaming company, SocialDeck enabled simultaneous game play across multiple mobile devices and social networks. The company was acquired by Google in 2010. At Google, Anish led various mobile product efforts and invested for Google Ventures.
Anish graduated from the University of Waterloo and lives in the Bay Area with his family. He has a passion for music and mixes tracks in his spare time.

speakers.name: Anna Dolganov
speakers.bio: Anna is a Roman historian at the Austrian Academy of Sciences pioneering the use of generative AI to decode, reconstruct and interpret some of humanity’s oldest written records. Anna received a BA in Classics from Harvard, an MPhil in Ancient History from King's College, Cambridge, and a PhD in Classics and Ancient History from Princeton. Her research sits at the intersection of ancient languages, artificial intelligence and cultural heritage, developing specialised AI systems capable of working with historical languages and fragmented historical documents. Anna has secured more than €1.6 million in competitive research funding and major Austrian research awards, and has built collaborations connecting leading researchers, cultural heritage institutions and technology partners. Together with Mistral AI and SAIL Reply, Anna leads research on domain-specific language models for Ancient Greek and Latin and explores how multimodal AI can combine text, images and contextual evidence to reconstruct damaged and fragmentary historical documents. Her work aims to move beyond general-purpose AI towards systems designed specifically for the distinctive challenges of humanity’s textual heritage—opening new possibilities for how we access, understand and preserve the human past.

speakers.name: Anna Huyghues Despointes
speakers.bio: Anna is co-founder of a stealth startup building infrastructure for AI-native biology data production. A network of autonomous wet labs, tightly integrated with foundation models, producing at scale the live, high-fidelity structured biological data to power the next generation of AI models in life sciences. She leads partnerships and go-to-market.

speakers.name: Anna Nozza
speakers.job_title: Chief People & Organization Officer Country Italia
speakers.bio: Graduated in Business Administration at L. Bocconi Commercial University of Milan. She began her professional activity in 1999 at Value Partners as a management consultant carrying out major international projects. She achieved her experience in the Human Resources area in several companies such as Sky Italia and Vodafone Italia. In March 2020 she held the position of HR Director Italy, Central East Europe and Greece at Accenture. Since March 2024 she is Chief People & Organization Officer at Generali Country Italia.

speakers.name: Annarosa Farina
speakers.job_title: Chief Information Officer & Chief Data Officer
speakers.bio:
am currently the CIDO, Chief Information and Data Officer at the European Oncology Hospital, IEO, and at Monzino Cardiologic Centre, CCM, both based in Milan, Italy, belonging to the same Group , IEO Group.
Ever since I have been appointed in 2019, I am in charge of the digital transformation of the core processes, enabling a faster and data driven approach through the adoption of digital platform and the collection of big and real world data, powered with AI. So far I have transformed almost all the running applications , achieved the re-platforming of the technological infrastructure, introduced new additional solutions and deployed the clinical data lake for researches and trials powered with NLP, LLM and AI techniques.
I have been working for the healthcare industry for more than 20 years always, focused on process streamlining, data capture at the point of care to be orchestrated through integration systems with the purpose of extracting value for the stakeholders- physicians, nurses, managers, care givers and above all patients.
In order to achieve the goal, I set innovative roadmaps through program and platform design and implementations, strategic thinking in alignment with institution strategy evolution, including budget cycle planning and change management.
Before joining the IEO Group I used to be Enterprise Architect and Application Manager in a large research hospital, namely San Raffaele Hospital, OSR, based in Milan, for 15 years, where my goal was to operate across organizational and computing areas in order to define architectural standards, drive common approaches and expose brand new information assets and processes across the enterprise.
I delivered systems based on an innovative architecture model that supports the most efficient and secure IT environment, according to the hospital business needs and GDPR requirements.
I changed all the existing applications running in the Hospital in the turn of a few years and afterwards I introduced many new ones.
In short I am passionate about my job, I love challenges and bound to be a game changer.

speakers.name: Anne Osdoit
speakers.bio:
Anne is the founding and current CEO of Moon Surgical, a company founded in Paris in 2020 that is driven by an intrinsic desire to advance global healthcare for patients, to innovate and inspire the art of surgery, and to make a difference through creativity, perseverance, and teamwork.
She is a Board member at both SafeHeal and May Health — two companies where she was also founding CEO and has also run the Sofinnova Partners in-house MedTech accelerator, MD Start, since 2015, as a Partner at Sofinnova Partners.
Anne has also held several key positions at Mauna Kea Technologies, a Paris-based international medical technology company developing a disruptive “optical biopsy” technology. She was closely involved in multiple financing rounds, including the company’s 2011initial public offering on the NYSE Euronext Exchange in Paris, a highly successful operation and the largest public listing for the sector that year.
She is an active angel investor and an independent board member of Cardiologs Technologies, a Paris-based digital health startup that was purchased by Philips in 2021.
She is a trained biomedical engineer with degrees from Ecole Polytechnique in Paris and Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, Maryland. She holds additional degrees in Biostatistics and epidemiology applied to clinical trials (Université Pierre et Marie Curie), as well as Corporate Finance (London School of Economics).

speakers.name: Antonio Filosa
speakers.bio: Antonio Filosa is Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director of Stellantis. He is also responsible for North America & American Brands.He has led Stellantis in both North and South America as well as in Global Quality and has served as CEO of the Jeep® brand.Filosa has extensive experience in purchasing and manufacturing operations, as well as overall business management and strategy.He joined the Fiat Group in 1999 where he assumed roles of increasing responsibility, including plant manager of the Betim facility (Brazil) and Head of Purchasing for the Latin America region.Filosa also served as the Head of Argentina as well as the Head of Alfa Romeo and Maserati brands for the Latin America region, positions he held from 2016 and 2018, respectively.He served as COO for FCA’s Latin America region and was a member of the FCA Group Executive Council from March 2018.Filosa holds a master’s degree in engineering from Politecnico di Milano (Italy) and an executive MBA from Fundação Dom Cabral (Brazil).

speakers.name: Benedetta di Robilant
speakers.bio: Dr. Benedetta di Robilant is a biotech entrepreneur and scientist with a PhD in Immunology and a Postdoctoral Fellowship at Stanford University, where she studied stem cells, aging, and age-related diseases including Down syndrome, Alzheimer’s disease, and fibrosis. She has experience translating academic discoveries into biotech ventures. Dr. di Robilant previously founded Dorian Therapeutics, a Stanford spinout acquired by Altos Labs and is now the co-founder and CEO of ProMIND Therapeutics, developing first-in-class therapies for neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental disorders. Her work sits at the intersection of aging, neuroscience and translational medicine, with a focus on advancing fundamental discoveries toward meaningful patient impact.

speakers.name: Beniamino Pagliaro
speakers.bio: Beniamino Pagliaro, born in Trieste in 1987, is a journalist, a managing editor at La Repubblica, and the founder of Good Morning Italia. He currently heads La Repubblica’s Turin newsroom, after previously working on the newspaper’s central editorial desk. Before that, he was Head of Digital Development at La Stampa (2015–2018) and worked for the ANSA news agency (2008–2015). His latest book is Boomers contro millennials. 7 bugie sul futuro e come iniziare a cambiare (HarperCollins, 2023). He also organized State of the Net, a conference on the internet industry, from 2008 to 2018.

speakers.name: Bianca Bonetti
speakers.bio:
Bianca is an international moderator and ecosystem builder, connecting people, ideas, and capital across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. She brings 10+ years of experience in entrepreneurship, partnerships, innovation, and community building, including roles in Venture Capital and Private Equity.
Bianca is a former Vice World Champion in Women’s Speed Downhill Skiing, representing the Italian National Team.
She holds a degree in Mathematics and she is the founder of Sisters Founders, a community supporting women entrepreneurs.
Her motto- “Beyond your limits.”

speakers.name: Bryan Kim
speakers.bio: Bryan Kim (BK) is the Founding Partner of Mido Capital, an early stage venture fund focused on AI products for the people - consumers, prosumers, creators and coders alike. He was previously a partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), where he invested primarily in AI applications and consumer products such as Eleven Labs, Function Health, Mirage AI, Slingshot AI, Partiful and BeReal. He also actively explores new categories and behaviors emerging at the frontier. Prior to a16z, he was at Snap helping the company scale through its hyper growth and IPO and earlier in his career, Bryan worked at Credit Suisse IBD. He holds a BA in Economics and International Relations from Carleton College and an MBA from Columbia Business School.

speakers.name: Calin Fabri
speakers.bio:
Host of the Venture Europe Show - featuring personal conversations with the entrepreneurs and investors creating a future worth getting excited about.
By day, he is an M&A banker. In between, he coaches VC-backed founders on their path to building category-defining companies. On a mission to support 10,000 founders by 2030.

speakers.name: Camilla Folladori
speakers.bio: Camilla Folladori graduated in Economics from Bocconi University in Milan and earned an MBA from INSEAD in Fontainebleau/Singapore. She began her career in telecommunications, working at European Parliament, Telecom Italia and Vodafone, before moving into strategic consulting at BCG and Roland Berger. In 2012, she joined Sisal as Head of Innovation and was later appointed Head of Payments & Services Business. In 2016, she worked on the renewal strategy for the SuperEnalotto concession, and since 2017 she has led Sisal’s international expansion as International Business Development Director. Since March 2023, Camilla has held the position of Chief Strategy Officer at Sisal, and as of January 1, 2025, she has expanded her role to Chief Strategy Officer at Flutter SEA.

speakers.name: Carolina Chiappero
speakers.bio: Carolina Chiappero is Innovation Manager at Juventus Football Club, where she founded and leads Juventus Forward, the Club's open innovation programme. Through the Forward Squad, a cohort-based model now in its second season, she connects startups with the Club's business units, investors and international partners, aiming to turn early pilots into structured collaborations across departments, from performance and fan engagement to facility management. Her work centres on embedding innovation within the Club- translating new ideas and technologies into tangible value, building internal trust and finding the right collaboration models, beyond venture clienting alone, to scale innovation.

speakers.name: Ceri Morgan
speakers.job_title: His Majesty's Trade Commissioner for Europe
speakers.company: UK Department for Innovation, Business, Science and Trade

speakers.name: Charlie Perreau
speakers.bio: Charlie has headed up Les Echos' Tech-Médias-Start-up service since September 2024. She was previously head of the Start-up department. Since leaving school, Charlie has always been involved in the start-up and tech sector, holding journalistic positions in media specializing in digital transformation topics. Over the years, she has developed a strong commitment to female entrepreneurship.

speakers.name: Charlotte Jee
speakers.bio: Charlotte is MIT Technology Review's news editor. She has extensive experience as an award-winning journalist covering tech and crops up regularly across international broadcast media.

speakers.name: Chris Caldwell
speakers.bio: Chris Caldwell is a transformative leader who has guided Concentrix (NASDAQ- CNXC) fromits roots as a scrappy startup to one of the most respected global technology and servicesleaders in the world. His journey with Concentrix goes back to the very start, when SYNNEX(NYSE- SNX) purchased a small B2B sales company with only 20 people in 2004 and taskedhim with turning it around. In 2006, they purchased another small company calledConcentrix and merged it with the B2B sales business to enter the customer experience(CX) industry. Fast forward to today, and Concentrix is ranked on the 2024 Fortune 500 listand designs, builds, and runs fully integrated, end-to-end solutions at speed and scaleacross the entire enterprise for industry-leading companies and visionary scale-ups alike.With 35+ years of unrivaled business experience across diverse global geographies, Chris isan expert at forming strategic company visions and plans that maximize growth. Under hisleadership, Concentrix has accomplished several industry-leading mergers andacquisitions, including IBM’s customer care business, Convergys, and Webhelp.

speakers.name: Claudio Stamile
speakers.job_title: Manager of AI R&D & Market Solutions

speakers.name: Daniele Lepido
speakers.bio:
Daniele Lepido is a Senior Reporter at Bloomberg News in Milan. He covers major Italian and European companies, corporate deals and technology, with a focus on investigations and exclusive stories.
He has spent more than 13 years at Bloomberg, after working for a decade at Il Sole 24 Ore, Italy's leading financial newspaper. He began his journalism career while still in high school, writing video game reviews.

speakers.name: Dario Leopoldo Omero Calogero
speakers.bio: Dario Calogero is an entrepreneur and investor with extensive experience in technology, sustainability, and innovation. For more than twenty years, he has led Maya Investments, a firm that backs scalable, high-impact solutions in the fields of digital technology, education, and the environment.He is the founder of Kaleyra Inc. (formerly Ubiquity), a global mobile communications company that was listed on the NYSE in 2019 and acquired by Tata Communications in 2023. Dario currently holds several strategic leadership roles- he serves as Senior Advisor to the CEO of D-Orbit, a leading space company; Vice President of VIOLA, an app combating street and gender-based violence; and Board Member of TrueLeap, an EdTech platform enhancing global access to education. He also sits on the Investment Committee of FoolFarm, a startup studio specializing in artificial intelligence, and since 2015 has been a Board Member of ISPI, one of Italy’s foremost geopolitical think tanks. Passionate about mentorship, he actively supports entrepreneurs and initiatives that foster inclusion, creativity, and excellence. In 2020, he was awarded the title of Knight of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic.

speakers.name: David Cis
speakers.bio:
David Cis has been Group Chief Operating Officer and CEO and Chairman of Generali Operating Service Platform since September 2022.
He has worked in Generali Group since 2014 where he held several roles over the years. From 2014 to 2016 David Cis was the Head of Generali Delivery Unit, then, from 2016 to 2022 he was Generali Italia Chief Operating Officer and from September 2022 he has been Group Chief Operating Officer and Chairman of Generali Operating Service Platform.
After the graduation cum laude in Engineering from the University of Tor Vergata in Rome and the Master's degree in Business Administration from the Said Business School of Oxford University, he had more than 10 years of experience in advising the top management of financial institutions and private equity companies in different geographical areas. 
He worked for Mckinsey & Company where he helped some of the largest Italian companies in the insurance sector to define the strategies, the business plans and the business development. From 2012 to 2014, David Cis worked in the Group Operations Area of SwissRe based in Zurich.

speakers.name: Davide Canavesio
speakers.bio:
Davide Canavesio, entrepreneur and investor with a passion for innovation and
development, is currently the CEO of OGR Torino, Fondazione CRT’s international hub
dedicated to technology, innovation, business acceleration and the fusion of art and
technology.
Entrepreneur across various sectors, from automotive to food, he leads Blooming Group, a
retail industry leader in Italy with over 500 employees. 
Canavesio has extensive academic and international experience, acquired through his
studies at the Harvard Kennedy School and his work carried out in London at Morgan
Stanley and Bain & Co.
He teaches Private Equity and Venture Capital, Entrepreneurship, and Corporate
Finance; at the University of Turin and ESCP Business School. He is also the founder of the
associations Nexto and Gammadonna, as well as the President of the Torino Innovation
Mile Promoting Committee. 
He has always invested in startups and actively supports the innovation ecosystem.

speakers.name: Davide Dattoli
speakers.bio:
“The best way to predict the future is to invent it.”

I founded Talent Garden at 21. Today it is the leading platform in Europe for digital education and AI transformation- over 35,000 professionals trained every year, more than 150 corporate clients, and a presence across 6 markets in Europe, Brazil, and Singapore.

Talent Garden has become a reference point for organizations and individuals integrating AI into everyday work — not just at the level of skills, but across culture, organization, and operating models. We work with large corporations on concrete transformation programs, and with thousands of professionals who want to stay relevant in a fast-changing market.

Over the past 10 years, thousands of startups have grown within our campuses, including many of the most successful Italian unicorns and scaleups. We support them and learn directly from how they build and operate, using those insights to train the next generation of professionals with the same skills and mindset.

I led Talent Garden as CEO for the first ten years. Today I serve as Founder & Executive Chairman.

I am Co-Founder and Chairman of the Investment Committee of Italian Founders Fund (IFF), the first Italian VC fund built by founders, for founders- over 100 entrepreneurs involved, around €100 million raised, focused on seed and pre-seed. The idea is simple- people who have built companies are better positioned to back the next ones.

I am co-founder and Chairman of Mirai, a Physical AI dual use company building autonomous systems and intelligence platforms for operations at sea. We develop the operating layer that integrates software, AI, sensing, and vehicles into a single system designed to run continuously in complex environments.

As an angel investor, I have backed more than 20 companies including Bending Spoons, WeRoad, Will Media, and other early-stage European ventures.

The common thread is building infrastructure — human, technological, and financial — that increases Europe’s competitive capacity. I focus on identifying talent, connecting it with capital, and creating the conditions for it to grow.

I regularly travel between Europe, China, and the United States to understand how markets and technology are evolving. I serve on the board of several organizations, including Fondazione Telethon. I attended executive programs at Stanford University and Harvard Business School.

speakers.name: Diego Piacentini
speakers.bio:
Diego Piacentini is the founder of View Different, an investment vehicle that supports entrepreneurs looking to scale their business and/or expand beyond their domestic markets. The core of his business career was with Amazon and Apple. At Amazon (2000-2016) he was Senior Vice President of the International Consumer Business and a member of the S-team. Prior to that, Diego joined Apple Computer Italy (1987) and was General Manager and Vice President of Apple EMEA from 1997-2000. Most recently, he served a two-year civil servant term (2016-2018) as the Italian Government Commissioner for the Digital Transformation, reporting directly to the Prime Minister.
Diego is currently Advisor of Vento, and a member of the Boards of Directors of DoorDash, The Economist Group, Nubank, and Voi Technology, a European multimodal micromobility provider. He is a Senior Advisor at KKR and an advisor/mentor to many founders and CEOs across Europe, the US, India, and other parts of the world.
His NGO affiliations include- mentor for Endeavor Global and board member of Endeavor Italy, which he co-founded in 2016; the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME), an independent global health research center at the University of Washington; and the Maasai Association, supporting education and health initiatives in Kenya.
Diego graduated with a BS degree in Economics from Milan-based University Bocconi in 1985.

speakers.name: Diletta Livi
speakers.bio:
Diletta Livi is a Partner at Alkemia Capital, where she leads Resilience Venture, a VC Fund focused on Industrial Deep Tech, investing across industrial automation & robotics, AI infrastructure and dual-use technologies.
She has over a decade of experience across venture capital, private equity, M&A and corporate development. Prior to joining Alkemia Capital, Diletta was Investment Director at a multi-family office, investing in high-growth technology companies. Earlier in her career, she worked in M&A at Mediobanca, in the international acquisitions team at Eurofins Scientific, and as Head of Corporate Development at a European fintech scale-up.
Diletta holds an MBA from INSEAD and a degree in Corporate Finance from Bocconi University. She  also serves on the Boards of Class Editori and the INSEAD Alumni Association Italy, where she is actively involved in the entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem.

speakers.name: Dinika Mahtani
speakers.bio:
Dinika is based in London and leads Cherry’s UK and Ireland investments strategy, foucsing on Cherry’s vertical software and AI investments, with key areas across Health, Commerce, Fintech. She also spends time in consumer tech. She is a former UberEats EMEA executive. She launched, managed, and scaled Uber’s e-bike brand, JUMP, in the UK, and ran finance and operations at the climate SaaS platform, Kaluza (part of the OVO group).
With backgrounds in both finance and mathematics from her two alma maters, London Business School and Northwestern University, Dinika began her professional career as a technology investment banker in New York.
Early-stage venture is a people business; Dinika’s knack for working with founders is a natural talent of hers. She has spent several years as an angel investor and advisor to female-founded startups, a deep area of passion. When not teaming up with Europe’s top founders, you might find her enjoying the best cinnamon buns London has to offer – their location? Top secret.

speakers.name: Diyala D'Aveni
speakers.bio: Diyala D'Aveni is Managing Partner and CEO of Vento, an early-stage venture fund backed by Exor and the most active early-stage private investor in Italy, with a portfolio of around 200+ companies. Vento works across three fronts- an early-stage fund, the Reef venture-building program, and Wave, this very conference.

speakers.name: Donatella Sciuto
speakers.bio:
Donatella Sciuto is Rector of Politecnico di Milano, where 
she is Full Professor of Computer Science and Engineer
ing. She graduated in Electronic Engineering at the same 
university, received her PhD in Electrical and Computer 
Engineering at the University of Colorado, Boulder (USA) 
and a Master’s Degree in Business Administration at Boc
coni University.
Since January 2023, she has been at the helm of the first 
technical university in Italy, as the only female Rector since 
its foundation. Member of the Board of Directors of the 
Bank of Italy, she also sits on various Boards of Directors 
of listed companies. She has been appointed IEEE Fellow, 
IBM Women Leader in Artificial Intelligence, Inspiring Fifty 
Italy, and member of the Academia Europaea

speakers.name: Dorothy Chou
speakers.bio: Dorothy Chou is a Strategic Advisor at Google DeepMind, where she spent nearly a decade leading the Public Engagement Lab, launching neglected disease partnerships for AlphaFold, and helping establish Google.org's AI for science fund. A long-time advocate for transparency and equity in tech, she created the first industry-standard Transparency Report at Google and has held senior roles at Uber, Dropbox, and Google, including work on criminal justice reform and self-driving policy. An active angel investor, Dorothy has backed more than 40 early-stage companies and holds LP stakes in seven VC funds across Europe and the US. She chairs UCLPartners, a health innovation partnership accelerating the adoption of new technology through the NHS, serves on the advisory board of the Human Rights Data Analysis Group, which uses AI and machine learning to support human rights cases around the world, and sits on the board of digital arts nonprofit Rhizome. Dorothy holds a B.S. in International Politics from Georgetown University's Walsh School of Foreign Service and an MSt in Practical Ethics from Oxford University.

speakers.name: Emanuele Levi
speakers.bio:
Emanuele Levi
CEO and General Manager of CDP Venture Capital since May 2025.
After earning a degree in Business Economics in Turin and completing a Corporate Finance program at the London Business School, Emanuele Levi began his career in 1993 at the Credito Italiano Group, first in London and later in Milan. In 1996, he moved to Bain & Company and then to Lazard Investment Banking in Milan.
Since 2000, he has focused on venture capital, initially at Pino Venture and later at 360 Capital, where he served as General Partner until 2025.

speakers.name: Emanuele Veratti
speakers.bio:
Emanuele is a member of Bain & Company’s Digital practice, with a particular focus on Artificial Intelligence, innovation and technology-driven transformation.
He advises leading companies on how to leverage AI, Generative AI, Advanced Analytics and emerging technologies to reinvent their businesses, accelerate growth and build new sources of competitive advantage. His work spans AI and digital strategy, large-scale transformation, new business building and innovation, as well as the development of technology and data capabilities required to bring AI from experimentation to enterprise-wide impact.
Alongside his cross-industry work on AI and innovation, Emanuele has deep sector expertise in advanced manufacturing and services and leads Bain’s local work across the airline, transportation and logistics sectors. His broader experience includes e-commerce and omnichannel strategy, marketing transformation, and organization design.
He holds a degree in Business Administration, cum laude, from the University of Bologna.

speakers.name: Eoin Hinchy
speakers.bio: Eoin Hinchy is the co-founder and CEO of Tines, the intelligent workflow platform. Prior to Tines, Eoin spent 15 years leading security operations at companies like eBay, PayPal, and DocuSign. He has two engineering degrees - a Masters in Security and Forensic Computing from Dublin City University and an MBA from Imperial College London.

speakers.name: Fabio Mondini de Focatiis
speakers.bio:
Fabio is the Founder of Growth Capital and brings more than 25 years of experience in venture capital, technology, entrepreneurship, and corporate leadership. From 2015 to 2022, he served as Venture Partner at Eurazeo, one of Europe's leading investment firms with more than €30 billion in assets under management, overseeing global venture investments in Smart Cities. He is also an active business angel and founding member of Growth Engine.
Earlier in his career, Fabio was Senior Advisor to the European Investment Fund, Senior Vice President at Soitec, where he led the growth and successful divestment of the Solar Division, and founder of RenEn Renewable Energy. He previously held leadership roles at McKinsey & Company, ENEL, and Russell Reynolds.
Fabio holds an MBA from INSEAD, an M.S. in Civil and Environmental Engineering from MIT, and a B.S. from the University of Naples Federico II.

speakers.name: Federico Ferrazza
speakers.bio: Federico Ferrazza is the editor-in-chief of Italian Tech and Green & Blue, the publications of the Gedi Group (publisher of Repubblica) that cover innovation and the environment issues. Until December 2024, he directed Wired Italia for 10 years. Since the end of 2025, he has published a newsletter in Repubblica entitled Tech Away.

speakers.name: Federico Minutoli
speakers.bio:
I am open-weights first.
we believe organizations will run their core processes on intelligence they control, drawing on a dynamic portfolio of frontier, open-weights, and specialized models across every modality, each doing the work it's best suited for.
building toward that future through a flywheel is the mission I'm after.

speakers.name: Federico Sargenti
speakers.bio: Federico Sargenti is CEO & Co-Founder of CommerceClarity, the AI agent platform that helps enterprise retailers and brands accelerate, scale, and control their catalog operations.He has over 15 years of international experience across e-commerce, technology, retail, and operations. He was previously CEO of Everli, where he grew the company from €1 million to €100 million in revenue and from 10 to 300 employees across multiple countries.Prior to that, he spent five years at Amazon as FMCG Category Leader for Italy and Spain, with P&L responsibility across Grocery, Wine, Beauty, and Healthcare.He co-founded Witailer, which was acquired by Retex in 2024, and has been an Endeavor Entrepreneur since 2017.

speakers.name: Fernanda Ferreira
speakers.bio:
Fernanda Ferreira is co-founder and CEO of Lindo, an AI-native agency for compliance, helping companies turn regulation into an end-to-end execution layer. She was part of the 5th batch of Reef, Vento's venture-building program.
Before founding Lindo, Fernanda founded AURA, an edtech platform for Brazilian students pursuing international education, which reached over 200,000 students across the country. She also previously worked as a consultant at Bain & Company.
Fernanda holds a degree in Economics from Bocconi University. She was born and raised in Brazil.

speakers.name: Filippo Rizzante
speakers.bio: Filippo Rizzante began his career at Reply in 1999. In his early years with the Group, he focused primarily on consulting and projects for the web division. In 2006, he became an Executive Partner at Reply, with responsibility for Group companies specialising in technology, security, Information Lifecycle Management, Web 2.0 and Open Source. Over the years, he took on increasingly senior roles within the Group, assuming direct responsibility for several business areas, including Architecture & Technologies, Digital Media and Mobile. Since 2012, as CTO of Reply, Filippo has led the development of new offerings driven by technological innovation, with a particular focus on artificial intelligence and its applications. He is also responsible for all Group-level partnerships. Filippo holds a degree in Computer Engineering from the Polytechnic University of Turin.

speakers.name: Filippo Santelli
speakers.bio: Filippo Santelli is a reporter for the Italian media oultet La Repubblica

speakers.name: Filippo Signoretti
speakers.job_title: Head of Group Business Development & Strategy
speakers.bio:
Filippo Maria Signoretti is Head of Group Business Development and Strategy at Nexi.
46 years old, he graduated in Telecommunication Engineering at University La Sapienza - Rome.
After his professional experience in Value Partners Management Consulting & Business Integration Partners as Senior Engagement Manager, leading projects and contributing to business development, from 2017 he performed various roles in Nexi, mainly in SME Multichannel G2M, Referral Books and Business Development and as Head of the Business Unit Merchant Solutions & eComm Italy
Hobbies- Music, books, beach volley, sailing, soccer.

speakers.name: Flora Bell
speakers.company: TPF Labs at The Players Fund
speakers.bio: Flora Bell is Managing Director of TPF Labs, the corporate venture arm of The Players Fund. She builds and runs venture programmes for rightsholders such as Tottenham Hotspur, Juventus and Como 1907, connecting them with high-growth startups to create new commercial opportunities. Before joining TPF, Flora spent several years at LaLiga Studios and, throughout her career, has worked with global brands including Magnum, Dove and Starbucks. Working closely with their leadership teams, she has built partnerships that grew brand reach, opened new routes to market and drove commercial growth. She is based in Madrid.

speakers.name: Floriano Masoero
speakers.bio:
Floriano Masoero è Presidente e CEO di Siemens in Italia dal 2022. Guida lo sviluppo della
filiale italiana in una fase cruciale di trasformazione digitale e industriale che vede
Siemens quale protagonista dell’Industrial AI, promuovendo l’adozione di tecnologie
avanzate come leve strategiche per aumentare competitività, resilienza e sostenibilità del
sistema produttivo e del Paese. Il suo approccio si fonda su una leadership dinamica e
inclusiva, basata su modelli organizzativi flessibili, sul coinvolgimento attivo dei giovani nei
processi decisionali e sulla creazione di ecosistemi aperti capaci di favorire collaborazione,
confronto e condivisione di competenze.
Si è laureato con Master in Ingegneria Elettronica presso il Politecnico di Torino,
conseguendo anche un MBA presso l'Università degli Studi di Torino.
Ha lavorato in Schneider Electric per 10 anni, durante i quali ha ricoperto ruoli
commerciali di crescente responsabilità fra l’Italia e la Francia, fino a diventare Global
Electric Vehicles Account Manager. In questo ruolo ha guidato la strategia di partnership e
i piani di sviluppo di Schneider Electric per le colonnine di ricarica con i principali
produttori di macchine elettriche.
Entrato in Eaton in Svizzera nel 2014 nel segmento ferroviario, dopo un percorso di
crescita accelerato in ambito marketing e commerciale, è stato Sales Director del Sud Est
Europa e prima ancora Country Managing Director dell'Italia. E' stato responsabile per
conto di Eaton anche del dipartimento di marketing EMEA e, a seguire, Vice President e
General Manager della Power Distribution Business unit. È membro del Board of Advisors della Fondazione Politecnico di Milano, membro del Board della Camera di Commercio Italo-Germanica (AHK Italien), membro dell’Advisory Board Investitori Esteri di Confindustria e membro del Consiglio Generale di Assolombarda. Inoltre, dal 2026 è Membro dell’International Advisory Board - School of Management - Politecnico di Milano.

speakers.name: Francesca Capella
speakers.job_title: Research Fellow and Scientific Director of Open Innovation Lookout Observatory
speakers.bio:
Francesca is a management engineer with a PhD in Management Engineering focused on Innovation Governance. She has worked at Politecnico di Milano for almost ten years in the innovation management field.
As a Research Fellow in the Innovation, Strategy and Family Business Research Group of Politecnico di Milano, she coordinates research projects and activities with companies on innovation management and open innovation. She has been part of the OI Lookout Observatory since it began. She started as an analyst and project manager and now sits on its scientific board.
She is a member of the Junior Faculty of Politecnico di Milano and of POLIMI Graduate School of Management (GSoM) where she teaches Innovation Strategy, Innovation Management and Open Innovation.
Francesca is an active researcher in the fields of innovation management and open innovation. Her recent works look at investigating corporate venturing initiatives such as venture clienting, governance dynamics in innovation, and the role of social and political capital in innovation activities.

speakers.name: Francesca Protano
speakers.job_title: CNH Head of Technology Strategy, Product Innovation and Sustainability
speakers.bio:
Francesca Protano is Head of Technology Strategy, Product Innovation and Sustainability at CNH, where she leads the development of long-term technology roadmaps, breakthrough innovation programs, and sustainability strategies across the company. Her work focuses on advancing artificial intelligence, automation, robotics, digital technologies, and sustainable solutions to help shape the future of agriculture. With almost 20 years of international experience, she has held leadership roles across R&D, Finance, Marketing, and Corporate Development, including Mergers & Acquisitions, Business Development, and Strategy. Most recently, she served as Managing Director of Ventures at CNH, where she led partnerships and venture initiatives aimed at accelerating innovation and expanding the company’s technology ecosystem. Francesca began her career at the Fiat Research Centre, working on cutting-edge projects in the automotive and industrial sectors. She holds a degree in Computer Science and Master's degrees in Mechatronics and an MBA in Innovation & Technology Management from Alma Graduate School and Bologna Business School International.
A strong advocate for open innovation and cross-industry collaboration, Francesca is passionate about turning emerging technologies into practical solutions that improve productivity, sustainability, and resilience. She regularly speaks on the intersection of AI, robotics, sustainability, and the future of intelligent machines, helping position agriculture as one of the next great frontiers for technological innovation.

speakers.name: Francesco Cerruti
speakers.bio: Francesco Cerruti is the Managing Director of Italian Tech Alliance since May 2020. Italian Tech Alliance is the association of those who invest, innovate, experiment and discover new technologies to foster the growth of Italy. It represents and promotes the needs of venture capital and corporate venture capital funds, business angels, family offices, start-ups and innovative SMEs. Prior to joining Italian Tech Alliance, Francesco has led the European team of the consultancy TPA Research and he has worked for five years in the European Parliament. He holds a Master in Global Politics at the London School of Economics and Political Sciences and a Master in Political Sciences at Università Statale di Milano. In 2022 he has been selected as a Fellow by Schmidt Futures International Strategy Forum. In 2018 he has been invited to the US International Visitor Leadership Programme with a focus on Global Economic Cooperation.

speakers.name: Francesco Simoneschi
speakers.bio:
Francesco Simoneschi is an Italian entrepreneur and investor, best known as the Co-Founder and CEO of TrueLayer - pioneers of the innovative ‘Pay by Bank’ method and Europe’s fastest-growing payment network, processing more than $100 Billion in payments each year. Since launching in 2016, TrueLayer has raised over $320 million from global investors including Tiger Global and Stripe, reaching a valuation of more than $1 billion.
Prior to founding TrueLayer, Francesco built a number of successful tech ventures across San Francisco and Europe. He co-founded the angel investment fund Mission and Market, served as Vice President of Strategy at FOVE, and founded the analytics platform Staq.io, later acquired by PlayHaven. He also held leadership roles at Upsight and DomainsBot.
Francesco is an active angel investor with over 60 startup investments, placing particular emphasis on trust, product-market fit and founder credibility. He often draws on his own experience as a repeat founder when supporting early-stage teams.
A recognised leader in fintech, Francesco is a vocal advocate for open banking and modernising financial services. He regularly collaborates with policymakers and industry stakeholders to drive innovation and competition in the sector.

speakers.name: Gabriel Guinea Montalvo
speakers.bio: Gabriel Guinea Montalvo is the co-founder and CEO of Pillar, the operating system for construction companies. Pillar began as an AI-native ERP for SME contractors, bringing jobsites, costs and workforce management into a single platform, and plans to expand across the entire construction value chain. Founded in Italy in 2025, the company has reached more than 1,000 customers in less than a year and has raised €15.2M, one of the largest seed rounds in the industry, from leading international investors including Earlybird Venture Capital and Base10 Partners.

speakers.name: Geoffrey Cain
speakers.bio: Geoffrey Cain is the award-winning author of Steve Jobs in Exile and a correspondent who sits down with world leaders, tech founders, and dissidents. His book Samsung Rising was longlisted for the Financial Times and McKinsey Business Book of the Year, and The Perfect Police State was named NPR’s “Book of the Day.” He appears in The Wall Street Journal, Time, The Economist, and Wired and has been featured on CNN and Bloomberg TV. He also advises executives and government officials on innovation.

speakers.name: Giacomo Luppi
speakers.bio: CEO & Co-founder of Chapeau Media, the largest business podcast in Italy reaching 3+ million people a month.

speakers.name: Gianmaria Monteleone
speakers.bio: Gianmaria Monteleone is a serial entrepreneur who began building businesses in his teens, fascinated by how innovation shapes culture, desire and what we value. He has built successful ventures in fiercely competitive sectors. Today he is the founder and CEO of Veliu, an agentic commerce lab bringing together talent from some of the world’s most sought-after tech companies. Its thesis is agentic selling- if AI changes how consumers discover, understand and choose, brands must change how they compete. Veliu develops technologies for the AI era, where purchases begin in conversation, websites reshape themselves for every individual visitor and digital assistants can buy on people’s behalf. The aim is to help brands embrace new ways to sell and position themselves, amplifying their identity and what makes them unique in the world.

speakers.name: Giorgio Chiellini
speakers.bio: Giorgio Chiellini has spent his life leading teams in moments of pressure, change, and ambition. A UEFA Euro 2020 champion, former captain and winner of more than 20 throphies with Juventus and Italy, and now Chief Club Affairs Officer, he has experienced firsthand what it takes to build trust, navigate complexity, and pursue excellence at the highest level.Today, he works at the intersection of sport, leadership, and organizational development, helping shape the future of one of the world's most iconic football clubs. Drawing from experiences gained both on the pitch and in the boardroom, Giorgio offers a powerful perspective on resilience, teamwork, innovation, and the human side of performance.

speakers.name: Giulio Michelon
speakers.bio:
Cosa Sposta is the best editorial project about the tech Italian companies, according to the host Giulio Michelon. Deep dives, interviews and a host that has been an entrepreneur for ten years before doing this.
Cosa Sposta?

speakers.name: Giuseppe Simone
speakers.company: Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori Regina Elena (IFO)
speakers.bio: Giuseppe Simone, MD, PhD, is a distinguished urologist renowned for his expertise in minimally invasive surgical techniques and uro-oncology. With extensive experience in managing complex urological conditions, Dr. Simone has contributed significantly to the advancement of laparoscopic and robotic-assisted surgeries, positioning himself as a leader in modern urological practice. Dr. Simone holds a prominent academic position, where he is actively involved in training the next generation of urologists. His dedication to education is complemented by a robust portfolio of research focusing on cancer diagnostics and treatment, and advancements in reconstructive urology. Through numerous peer-reviewed publications and presentations at international conferences, he has helped shape contemporary approaches to patient care. In addition to his clinical and academic roles, Dr. Simone is engaged in various professional societies, fostering collaborative research and promoting innovation within the urological community. His commitment to excellence and patient-centered care continues to influence both clinical outcomes and urological education worldwide.

speakers.name: Guglielmo Caviasso
speakers.job_title: VP GLOBAL HEAD OF DIGITAL INTEGRATION AND VEHICLE VALIDATION

speakers.name: Guive Balooch
speakers.job_title: Global Vice President, Technology and Open Innovation
speakers.bio:
Guive Balooch is the Global VP of Tech and Open Innovation at L’Oréal, transforming the beauty company into a technology leader since joining the group 19 years ago. He established the  Technology Incubator in 2012, which evolved into the Augmented Beauty Division, of which he leads today. In 2019, his role expanded to oversee Open Innovation, which focuses on partnerships 
with leading global startups in biotech, longevity, the microbiome, and other emerging fields key to the group’s future.

Under Balooch’s direction, the Augmented Beauty team creates innovative, sustainable products addressing unmet consumer needs through technology. Working with Research & Innovation and cross-divisional teams across the organization, his team has produced breakthrough innovations including Make Up Genius, the first virtual makeup try-on app; HAPTA, a stabilizing makeup applicator for limited mobility users; personalized skincare diagnostic device Cell BioPrint, and AirLight Pro, 
an energy-efficient, infrared powered hairdryer, among others.

Balooch also leads L’Oréal’s Open Innovation strategy, extending R&I beyond internal capabilities through strategic partnerships in biotech, green sciences, longevity, supplements, and other 
promising fields. Examples include recent investments in Shinehigh Biotech (China) and Debut Biotech (California), focused on scaling and innovating biotech compounds, as well as the latest investment in Timeline (Switzerland), the world’s leader in longevity supplements, and many more. This dual approach to innovation, combining internal technology development with external partnerships, enables L’Oréal to address the evolving needs of consumers while advancing into new frontiers for the beauty industry.

A California native, Balooch holds a B.A. in Molecular and Cell Biology from UC Berkeley, a Ph.D. in Biomaterials from UC San Francisco, and completed post-doctoral research at Stanford in cell biomechanics. He is a member of the Consumer Technology Association’s (CTA) Board of Industry Leaders.

speakers.name: Ian King
speakers.bio: Ian King has been a financial journalist for national newspapers and television in the United Kingdom for more than 30 years. After several years working in the City at the start of his career, he has worked for The Daily Telegraph, The Guardian, The Mail on Sunday and The Sun before joining The Times where he was an award-winning Business & City Editor. His work has also been published in The Sunday Times, The Sun on Sunday and the Financial Times. In 2014 he became business presenter at Sky News, presenting more than 2,000 live editions of the channel's flagship business programme, interviewing three Bank of England governors, half a dozen Chancellors of the Exchequer and more than half of the chief executives in the FTSE-100. Since leaving Sky News last year he has continued to write for The Times and the FT. He is also a contributor to and occasional presenter for CNBC.

speakers.name: Ignasi Costas
speakers.job_title: Founder & Partner RCD. Head of Innovation & Entrepreneurship. General Secretary Tech Barcelona.

speakers.name: Inès Makula
speakers.bio: Inès Makula is a podcaster, entrepreneur, and speaker, best known as the co-host of Made IT, one of Italy’s leading podcasts. Through her work, she has interviewed hundreds of top entrepreneurs, athletes, and business leaders, uncovering the real stories behind success- the ambition, the failures, and the mindset it takes to build something meaningful.

speakers.name: Irwan Bello
speakers.bio: Irwan Bello is the CEO and Co-founder of Aire, a company empowering organizations across global R&D to conduct frontier AI research. Prior to founding Aire, he was a founding team member and Research Lead at Reflection, and Character.ai. He previously served as a Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI, contributing to ChatGPT and GPT-4, and as a Research Scientist at Google Brain.

speakers.name: Jack Zhang
speakers.bio:
Jack Zhang is the co-founder and CEO of Airwallex, the AI-native banking and payments platform helping businesses manage their financial operations at global scale.
Jack co-founded Airwallex in 2015 to rebuild global financial infrastructure for modern businesses. That mission has grown into one of the world's most comprehensive financial platforms, spanning 85+ licenses across America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Today Airwallex powers global business banking, payments, cards, billing and spend management for over 675,000 businesses around the world.
Alongside Airwallex, Jack founded Capital49, a venture fund investing in early-stage, high-growth companies building the future of finance, commerce, and AI-driven enterprise software.

speakers.name: Jake Stauch
speakers.bio: Jake is the co-founder and CEO of Serval, the AI platform IT teams. Serval deploys AI agents to automate help desk requests, onboarding/offboarding, and other IT workflows for companies like General Motors, Fox, Snowflake, Ramp and Perplexity. Serval has raised over $125M in funding from Sequoia, General Catalyst, Redpoint, First Round, and others.

speakers.name: James Anderson
speakers.bio:
James Anderson joined Lingotto in April 2023 as Managing Partner and CIO of the Lingotto Innovation Strategy. James brings with him 40 years of investing experience.
Prior to joining Lingotto, James was a Partner at Baillie Gifford from 1987 until 2022.  He led Baillie Gifford’s flagship fund, the Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust from 2000 until his departure.  He led much of the firm’s growth strategy for the past few decades as co-manager of several additional funds (International Concentrated Growth and Global Outliers strategies, Long-Term Global Growth strategy, and Vanguard International Growth strategy) and through his many leadership roles.
James has served as a member of the Advisory Board of the government sponsored Kay Review and Chair of the subsequent industry working group that set up the UK Investor Forum.  James graduated with a BA in History from the University of Oxford.  After postgraduate study in Italy and Canada he gained an MA in International Affairs in 1982.  James is a Trustee of the Johns Hopkins University, a member of the Investment Committee of University College, Oxford and a non-executive Director at Heart of Midlothian Football Club.

speakers.name: James Cadwallader
speakers.bio: James Cadwallader is the Co-founder and CEO of Profound, the marketing platform for the era of Superintelligence. Relied on by thousands of marketers globally, Profound enables brands to understand, control, and scale how they appear across AI Search. Trusted by Figma, Walmart, Ramp, MongoDB, Chime, and U.S. Bank, Profound arms visionary marketers with the tools to win the zero-click internet. Launched in August 2024, Profound is backed by Sequoia Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Kleiner Perkins, Khosla Ventures, and NVIDIA Ventures.

speakers.name: James Mitra
speakers.bio:
James Mitra is the Founder of JBM, an award-winning executive search firm working with some of the fastest growing Tech Startups & Scaleups in the world.
He is also Co-Founder of Amplified Group, a people services group supporting Tech firms from inception to IPO with fractional and embedded people and talent, exceutive search and leadership development/management training.
James has been recognised as a LinkedIn Top Voice for Careers and also hosts of one of the UK’s top business and career podcasts, 40 Minute Mentor, which has had 1.5m downloads to date, featuring career stories and mentorship from world class business leaders, entrepreneurs and sporting legends.
He is also a Board Advisor in the Impact accelerator, Unrest.
Outside of work, James loves spending travelling with his wife and daughter and is a lifelong (and long suffering) Aston Villa footballl fan.

speakers.name: James Peng
speakers.bio: Dr. James Peng is the Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Pony.ai. Dr. Peng is responsible for overall strategic planning, business development, operations and management of the Group. Prior to founding the Group, Dr. Peng served as the Chief Architect at Baidu (Nasdaq- BIDU, HKEX- 9888) in charge of the research and development of Baidu’s autonomous driving unit. Prior to that, Dr. Peng worked at Alphabet Inc. (Nasdaq- GOOGL, GOOG), during which time he received the highest internal honor, the Google Founder’s Award. Dr. Peng obtained a bachelor’s degree from Tsinghua University in the PRC, and a doctorate degree from Stanford University in the United States.

speakers.name: James Wall
speakers.job_title: Vice President Product Management and Medical Offer

speakers.name: Jean Christophe Laloux
speakers.job_title: Director General - Head of EU Lending and Advisory
speakers.bio:
Jean-Christophe Laloux is Director General – Head of EU Lending and Advisory Operations at the European Investment Bank (EIB), the long-term financing institution of the European Union.
During his twelve-year tenure heading the EIB’s frontline, his teams have cumulatively delivered three quarter of a trillion euros in new lending operations, a record in the institution's 68-year history. He has been instrumental in progressively transforming the business delivery model of the Bank. Under his leadership and in close partnership with the European Commission, the European Investment Bank (EIB) has developed new high impact financing instruments, including venture debt for high-tech startups (currently around €10 billion invested in 400 companies), risk-sharing instruments in partnership with European banks, new approaches to construction, merchant and technology risk in project finance structures, anchor subscription on primary markets to green bonds issued by European corporates, and counter-guarantees for the European wind industry (currently €6.5 billion deployed). Today, 75% of the Bank’s clients are private sector counterparts.
Prior to his current function, he held various frontline positions since joining the EIB in 1999 and was also the Head of Human Resources (2011-2013).
Before joining the Bank, he was a management consultant at the Boston Consulting Group and PricewaterhouseCoopers.
He holds a degree in Commercial Engineering from the Catholic University of Leuven, a post-graduate degree in Management (magna cum laude) from the University of Ghent, and a Master of Business Administration (distinction) from the Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University, United States.

speakers.name: Joe Schorge
speakers.bio: Joe Schorge is the Founder and Managing Partner of Isomer Capital, headquartered in London and focused exclusively on European venture capital. Isomer accesses high-potential opportunities in European technology through limited partner investments in early-stage funds, company co-investments, and secondary purchases of both funds and company positions. Joe has 30 years of experience as an LP, GP and technology operations executive, previously at Pomona Capital, a leading global secondaries firm, and at Cambridge Associates responsible for advising institutional investors on private equity investments. Joe began his career in information technology operating roles at Invensys plc (now Schneider Electric) in the US and Europe. He received a BS in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Massachusetts, Dartmouth and an MBA from London Business School.

speakers.name: Joe Tsai
speakers.bio:
Joe Tsai is a Co-founder and Chairman of Alibaba Group, a global technology company focused on AI and cloud computing for enterprises and the retail economy serving over 800 million consumers in China. He is a member of the boards of directors of Alibaba Group and its fintech affiliate Ant Group.
Tsai owns several professional sports teams, including the NBA Brooklyn Nets and the 2024 WNBA Champions New York Liberty, and is an investor in the NFL Miami Dolphins and the Miami Formula One Grand Prix. He is a major contributor to the sport of lacrosse as owner of the San Diego Seals and Las Vegas Desert Dogs in the National Lacrosse League, lead investor in the Premier Lacrosse League, and supporter of the sport’s international governing body World Lacrosse.
Tsai is a member of Asia Business Council, J.P. Morgan International Council, EXOR Partners Council, BDT & MSD Partners Advisory Board, and International Advisory Council of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
Prior to joining Alibaba Group in 1999, Tsai was a private equity investor in Asia for Investor AB of Sweden’s Wallenberg family. He practiced tax law as an associate with Sullivan & Cromwell LLP in New York. He is a graduate of The Lawrenceville School (’82), Yale College (B.A. ’86) and Yale Law School (J.D. ’90).

speakers.name: Johannes Reck
speakers.bio: Johannes Reck is the Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of GetYourGuide and sets the vision and strategy for the company. Since 2009, Johannes has been responsible for overseeing the growth of the company, driving it to become the leading global online booking platform for unique travel experiences, with more than 200 million booked experiences across 12,000+ cities. As CEO, he leads a dedicated team of more than 850 employees from GetYourGuide’s headquarters in Berlin, Germany.Johannes's passion for unique travel experiences, discovered during his studies, now shapes our company's culture, product, and partnerships. His mission to offer moments of discovery and wonder connects millions of travelers with over 35,000 global experience providers annually.Johannes actively supports other startup founders in their early stages by serving as an investor, mentor, and board member. He is a longtime member of the German Startup Association, which he joined in after founding GetYourGuide, but now largely focuses on mentorship as a commitment to give back to the next generation of innovative German founders and companies. His goal is to inspire positive change in the world, whether in business, as an investor, training for the next marathon, or in his roles as a father and partner.Johannes grew up in Cologne, Germany, and holds a master’s degree in biochemistry from ETH Zurich.

speakers.name: John Elkann
speakers.bio:
John Elkann is Chief Executive Officer of Exor N.V., Chairman of Ferrari N.V., and Chairman of Stellantis N.V.
Mr. Elkann began his career in 2001 at General Electric on the Corporate Audit Staff, working across Asia, Europe, and North America. In 2003, he joined Fiat Group and contributed to its transformation into Fiat Chrysler, a global automotive leader. In 2021, FCA’s merger with PSA created Stellantis, one of the world’s largest car manufacturers. As Ferrari's Chair since 2018, he has been bolstering the company's uniqueness across its three souls- racing, sports car and lifestyle.
In 2009, Mr. Elkann formed Exor, one of Europe’s largest diversified investment companies and the reference shareholder of companies such as Ferrari, Philips, Stellantis and CNH. He is the founder and chair of Lingotto, an investment management company he launched in 2023 with a focus on delivering attractive long-term returns. He is also the founder of Vento, a platform supporting the next generation of Italian entrepreneurs globally and the organiser of Wave (formerly Italian Tech Week), one of Europe’s most influential tech conferences.
Mr. Elkann is a board member of Meta and a trustee of MoMA. He chairs the Agnelli Foundation, a philanthropic organisation focused on education and is also a member of the J.P. Morgan International Council and the Allianz International Advisory Board. Mr. Elkann earned a scientific baccalauréat from Lycée Victor Duruy in Paris and an engineering degree from Politecnico di Torino.

speakers.name: Jonathan Godwin
speakers.bio: Prior to founding Orbital, Jonathan was a research at DeepMind leading efforts in materials science.

speakers.name: Jony Ive
speakers.bio: Born in London, he moved to California in 1992 to join Apple. As Chief Design Officer, he was responsible for the design of hardware, user interface, packaging and major architectural projects. Steve Jobs described Jony as his spiritual partner saying, “The difference that Jony has made not only at Apple but in the world is huge.” Their unique partnership defined a profound and enduring cultural legacy. Jony led the design of iconic and category-defining products including the iMac, iPod, iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. He holds more than 14,300 design and utility patents, uniquely spanning both hardware and software. He was awarded the Royal Society of Arts Benjamin Franklin Medal in 2004, and was described as “one of the most influential individuals in modern technology” when presented with the Professor Stephen Hawking Fellowship in 2019. Jony holds honorary doctorates from distinguished universities including Cambridge, Oxford and the Royal College of Art, where he currently serves as Chancellor. He was knighted at Buckingham Palace in 2012. In 2019 he founded the creative collective LoveFrom with his friend and fellow designer Marc Newson. In 2024 he co-founded io, an engineering and product development company committed to creating AI-enabled products, in close collaboration with both LoveFrom and OpenAI. Jony lives and works with his family in San Francisco.

speakers.name: Judith Dada
speakers.bio: Judith is a General Partner at Visionaries Club. Previously, she was General Partner at La Famiglia, a European seed stage venture capital fund investing into B2B technology companies that enable or disrupt large industries. In 2024, La Famiglia merged with US-based VC firm General Catalyst, where she worked as Partner. Judith focuses on enterprise and AI-driven business models. Her portfolio includes companies like Personio, Parloa, Orben, Buynomics, Ethon and Black Forest Labs. She started her career at Facebook, managing Amazon Europe’s product and marketing strategy and Facebook’s VC Initiative.

speakers.name: Julia Nasi
speakers.bio: Julia Nasi leads strategic partnerships at Veevi, building the ecosystem around ethical, provenance-certified AI digital twins for professional athletes. Her background spans FIFA, sports tech startups, athlete relations, and venture advising, giving her deep insight into how rights holders and organisations can harness AI responsibly. At Veevi, she architects partnerships bridging athletes, sports organisations, and technology platforms, most recently as part of the Juventus Forward Program.

speakers.name: Julien Roux
speakers.bio: Julien Roux is co-founder and CRO of Nebuly, the ROI platform for enterprise AI. Nebuly serves a global customer base including Oura, Vodafone and CNH Industrial. Trained as an engineer in Turin and Chicago, Julien spent his early career as a fundamental investor at a long/short equity hedge fund in London, where he originated and managed equity positions north of $100m, before founding Nebuly in 2022 on a simple observation- enterprises were spending millions on AI with no idea what they were getting back. He’s lived in 7 countries across 3 continents, but you’ll find him skiing and climbing mountains in his native Valle d’Aosta whenever he’s not working.

speakers.name: Kitty Mayo
speakers.bio: Kitty Mayo is the CEO of Project Europe, a platform backing the most ambitious under-25 technical founders across the continent. Prior to founding Project Europe, she spent six years at Entrepreneur First, leading programmes that helped hundreds of founders form companies and raise early capital. She has a background spanning software engineering, teaching, and architecture, and has dedicated her career to building institutions that enable young people to realise transformational ambitions.

speakers.name: Leah Hodgson
speakers.bio: Leah Hodgson is the London-based European private markets deputy editor for PitchBook, primarily covering the venture capital ecosystem across Europe and the Middle East. Leah, who joined PitchBook in 2018, graduated from the University of Surrey with a BA in international politics with French. She has previously been a radio reporter in France. She later turned to financial journalism, covering the wealth management industry.

speakers.name: Liam Boyle
speakers.bio:
Liam Boyle is the Head of Data & Business Intelligence at BYOMA, a trailblazing brand that disrupted the skincare industry by challenging over-complicated routines to pioneer skin-barrier health. Liam applies that same ethos to technology; just as BYOMA focused on the essentials, he helps scaling companies cut through the noise of emerging tech to deploy lean, powerful AI, BI, and data architectures.
His background includes driving digital transformation programs for the CIOs of Cisco and Thomson Reuters, Liam recently established BYOMA's group-wide data function, securing the critical system split that launched the brand as a standalone entity.
He is also the founder of Panoptic Digital, a consulting collective helping SMEs leverage modern tech to disrupt their own industries. Liam holds credentials in Physics from NUI Galway and Financial Control from the University of Aberdeen. Originally from Rosbeg, Donegal, he is now based in Glasgow.

speakers.name: Linda Rottenberg
speakers.bio: Linda Rottenberg is one of the world’s leading voices on global entrepreneurship, venture capital, and ecosystem transformation. She has been named “Innovator for the 21st Century” (TIME), one of “America’s Best Leaders” (U.S. News & World Report), “the World’s Mentor Capitalist” (Tom Friedman), and “the Entrepreneur Whisperer” (ABC). As Co-Founder & CEO of Endeavor, Linda built a global network that identifies, mentors, and invests in the highest growth entrepreneurs across 50+ countries — showcasing the power of innovation “elsewhere”. Endeavor’s global investment fund, Endeavor Catalyst, manages $540M in AUM across four funds, with over 375 investments and 64 “unicorn” companies valued at $1B+. Linda currently serves on two public company boards- Globant, a leading digital transformation company (NYSE- GLOB); and Pershing Square SPARC Holdings (SPARC). She is a founding member of the Yale Ventures Advisory Board and Vice-Chair of Yale President’s Council on International Activities. In 2014, Linda published CRAZY IS A COMPLIMENT, a New York Times bestseller. She has been the subject of one Stanford and five Harvard Business School case studies. A graduate of Harvard College and Yale Law School, Linda lives in Brooklyn with her husband, author Bruce Feiler, and visits her identical twin daughters in college when she’s not traveling the world.

speakers.name: Luana Lara Lopes
speakers.bio: Luana Lopes Lara is co-founder and COO of Kalshi, the largest prediction market in the world. The exchange trades hundreds of millions of contracts monthly and offers contracts on politics, sports, economics, and entertainment, among many others. Kalshi has raised over $500M in funding from investors including Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Paradigm, and Spark Capital. Before founding Kalshi, Luana worked as a quantitative trader at Citadel Securities and as a software engineer at Bridgewater Associates. Luana earned a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Mathematics at MIT. She was a professional ballerina with the Bolshoi Ballet School before starting at MIT. She is originally from Brazil.

speakers.name: Luca Bocchio
speakers.bio:
Luca joined Balderton as a Partner in 2026.
Luca brings more than a decade of experience investing in the European technology ecosystem, investing across fintech, consumer, AI applications, as well as defence and energy. Most recently as a Partner at Accel and previously at H14, Luca has backed a number of category-defining businesses including Trade Republic, SumUp, Vinted, GetYourGuide and Fuse Energy.
Prior to investing, Luca was a senior consultant at Bain & Co., advising technology and consumer companies across Europe and Asia.
Luca is originally from Italy and holds a Bachelor and MSc in Engineering management from LIUC University.

speakers.name: Luca De Angelis
speakers.bio:
Luca De Angelis is the CEO of the Tech Europe Foundation (TEF), a Milan-based nonprofit working to close the gap between Europe's strong scientific research and the small number of deep tech startups that come out of it. His appointment was announced in June 2025, when TEF started operating.
He started his career in finance, first as a banks analyst at Goldman Sachs and then as a senior investment associate at Bridgewater Associates. He later moved into Italian government. He served as Deputy Chief of Staff to the Minister of Technological Innovation and then as Director General for Emerging Technologies at the Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy. He has an undergraduate degree from Bocconi University and an MBA/MPP from Harvard.
At TEF he has built out programs that fund research, train students and support startups. These include PhD and postdoc fellowships, the TEF Ignition program for students, TEF Foundry and CDL-Milan, run with Bocconi and Politecnico di Milano. In January 2026, the innovation hubs of Politecnico (Polihub) and Bocconi (B4i) merged into TEF. In its first 15 months, TEF raised about €130 million, funded 111 research projects and supported 78 startups. His stated long-term goals are €1 billion in funding and 1,000 startups a year. His view is that Europe doesn't lack talent or research money; it lacks a system that turns ideas into companies.

speakers.name: Luca Ferrari
speakers.bio:
Luca Ferrari is a co-founder and the CEO of Bending Spoons. The company’s products, which include AOL, Brightcove, Eventbrite, Evernote, komoot, Meetup, Remini, StreamYard, Vimeo, and WeTransfer, among others, have served more than a billion people, with around 400 million monthly active users and 10 million paying customers, including many Fortune 500 enterprises.
Prior to co-founding Bending Spoons, Luca worked at McKinsey & Company. He holds a B.Sc. in Information Engineering and an M.Sc. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from the University of Padua, and an M.Sc. in Telecommunications Engineering from the Technical University of Denmark.

speakers.name: Manny Medina
speakers.bio:
Manny Medina is the Founder and CEO of Paid, the monetization platform for AI-native companies. Previously, he co-founded and led Outreach from startup to a $4.4 billion valuation, growing it to 6,000 customers, 800 employees, and $250 million in annual recurring revenue. At Paid, Manny is building the commercial infrastructure for the AI agent economy, after recognizing that traditional SaaS pricing (charging per seat or per user) breaks down when one employee can run dozens of agents, or agents work autonomously in the background. 
Paid gives AI companies one place to design pricing and packaging, track cost and margin per agent, and prove the value delivered to every customer. Having raised over $32.5 million from Lightspeed, Sequoia, and EQT Ventures,  he's building the platform that ensures AI agents get paid — profitably.

speakers.name: Marcello Ascani
speakers.bio: Marcello Ascani is Italy’s #1 business content creator, as well as an entrepreneur and investor. He is the founder of Flatmates, a media company helping brands and creators produce high-quality content. Through his work, he interviews leading entrepreneurs and takes his audience behind the scenes of Italy’s most outstanding companies and manufacturing excellence.

speakers.name: Marcello Restelli
speakers.bio: Marcello Restelli is a Full Professor at the Department of Electronics, Information and Bioengineering at Politecnico di Milano, where he coordinates the Real-Life Reinforcement Learning Research Lab (RL3). He is the author of more than 250 international scientific publications, primarily focused on the study and development of new reinforcement learning techniques. His research results are applied to real-world problems through numerous industrial collaborations in diverse sectors, including finance, e-commerce, Industry 4.0, and automotive. He is an ELLIS Fellow and serves as the research lead for the Artificial Intelligence Observatory of Politecnico di Milano. In 2020 and 2024, he co-founded ML cube and Trade RL, two spin-offs of Politecnico di Milano, where he is currently a scientific advisor.

speakers.name: Marco Argenti
speakers.bio:
Marco is the firm’s chief information officer. He is a member
of the Management Committee, the Firmwide Technology
Risk Committee, the Firmwide Enterprise Risk Committee,
and the Firmwide Artificial Intelligence Risk Committee.
Marco joined the firm as a partner in 2019.
Prior to joining Goldman Sachs, Marco served as vice
president of technology of Amazon Web Services (AWS)
since 2013, where he started and ran several AWS
businesses, including mobile, serverless computing, Internet
of Things, and augmented and virtual reality. Before that, he
spent several years at Nokia Corporation, where he was
senior vice president and global head of Developer
Experience and Marketplace from 2011 to 2013, with
responsibility for Nokia’s developer ecosystem and app store
across the company’s entire product portfolio.
Earlier in his career, Marco was a board member and chief
executive officer of internet and mobile company Dada
S.p.A., as well as a board member, executive vice president
of strategy development and chief technology officer of
Canadian e-commerce solutions provider Microforum Inc.,
where he founded Internet Frontier Inc., an internet
publisher and e-commerce retailer. He previously founded
and sold Dreamware S.r.l., a software development firm, to
Microforum Inc.
Marco serves on the Board of Advisors for the Fred
Hutchinson Cancer Center and is a board member emeritus of Pancreatic Cancer Action Network. In addition, he is a
member of the Board of Trustees of Carnegie Hall and
Mount Sinai.
Marco earned a master’s degree in Informatics Engineering
from Università di Pisa – Facoltà di Ingegneria and a
Professional Engineering qualification in Management
Engineering from Politecnico di Milano.

speakers.name: Marco Gay
speakers.bio:
Marco Gay, CEO di Zest S.p.A  
(Bio)  
Marco Gay è CEO e socio di ZEST S.p.A., nata nel 2024 dalla fusione tra Digital Magics e LVenture 
Group, quotata su Euronext Milan. 
Zest è il primo gruppo italiano, con sede a Milano, Torino e Roma, di dimensione europea dedicato alla 
crescita dell’ecosistema innovazione, leader di mercato in Italia negli investimenti early-stage – seed 
in startup e PMI Innovative, nell’accelerazione di startup, nell’Open Innovation e Corporate Venturing.  
Torinese, classe 1976, sposato con 3 figli, con oltre 20 anni di esperienza imprenditoriale nel settore 
digitale e dell’innovazione. Le sue radici provengono da una famiglia imprenditoriale, che all’insegna 
dei valori e dell’etica ha formato il suo carattere e la sua visione della vita. È stato Presidente di 
Confindustria Piemonte nell'ultimo quadriennio ed è stato Presidente di Anitec-Assinform dal 2018 a 
maggio 2024. Da luglio 2024 Marco Gay è il Presidente di Unione Industriali Torino.  
In precedenza, Gay si è occupato di management aziendale e business strategy- ha ricoperto la
